cycles.label: Opportunity
cycles.purpose: Explore ideas, problems, and evidence worth pursuing.

phases.label: Discovery
phases.purpose: Explore problems, users, context, and unknowns.

phases.label: Validation
phases.purpose: Test whether the problem and opportunity are supported by sufficient evidence.

cycles.label: Product Strategy
cycles.purpose: Choose the market, customer, positioning, and business direction.

phases.label: Positioning
phases.purpose: Define who the product is for and why it should be chosen.

phases.label: Business Model
phases.purpose: Define how value creation and value capture are expected to work.

cycles.label: Product Definition
cycles.purpose: Turn validated strategy into a bounded, measurable product definition.

phases.label: Scope
phases.purpose: Choose the smallest coherent product scope that tests the critical hypothesis.

phases.label: Requirements
phases.purpose: Define required behavior, boundaries, and acceptance outcomes.

phases.label: Experience Design
phases.purpose: Define end-to-end user flows, states, and recovery paths.

phases.label: Measurement Design
phases.purpose: Define how product behavior and outcomes will be measured.

cycles.label: Delivery
cycles.purpose: Design, plan, build, and integrate the product.

phases.label: Technical Design
phases.purpose: Choose proportionate architecture and technical trade-offs.

phases.label: Implementation Planning
phases.purpose: Turn intended design into executable, dependency-aware work.

phases.label: Build
phases.purpose: Implement the intended product behavior and supporting systems.

phases.label: Integration
phases.purpose: Connect components and dependencies into a coherent working system.

cycles.label: Verification
cycles.purpose: Establish evidence that the product works, is usable, and is safe enough for its intended exposure.

phases.label: Product QA
phases.purpose: Check product behavior against requirements and acceptance expectations.

phases.label: Runtime Verification
phases.purpose: Verify behavior in the actual running environment rather than from static inspection alone.

phases.label: Security & Reliability
phases.purpose: Evaluate security, resilience, recovery, and operational failure modes.

phases.label: UX Validation
phases.purpose: Validate that intended users can complete important flows successfully.

cycles.label: Go-to-Market
cycles.purpose: Prepare and expose the product to intended users with a deliberate distribution path.

phases.label: Launch Preparation
phases.purpose: Prepare product, support, analytics, messaging, and rollback for launch.

phases.label: Distribution
phases.purpose: Choose and execute realistic paths to reach intended users.

cycles.label: Growth
cycles.purpose: Improve acquisition, value realization, monetization, retention, and expansion.

phases.label: Acquisition
phases.purpose: Bring qualified users into the product.

phases.label: Activation
phases.purpose: Help new users reach the first meaningful value moment.

phases.label: Engagement
phases.purpose: Increase meaningful repeated product usage.

phases.label: Monetization
phases.purpose: Convert delivered value into sustainable revenue.

phases.label: Retention
phases.purpose: Keep users who continue receiving meaningful value.

phases.label: Referral
phases.purpose: Turn satisfied users into an acquisition channel where appropriate.

phases.label: Expansion
phases.purpose: Increase value and adoption within existing users or accounts.

cycles.label: Operations
cycles.purpose: Run, support, optimize, and maintain the product over time.

phases.label: Product Operations
phases.purpose: Operate support, monitoring, incident response, and routine product processes.

phases.label: Optimization
phases.purpose: Improve performance, cost, reliability, usability, or conversion using evidence.

phases.label: Maintenance
phases.purpose: Keep the product healthy while managing technical and operational debt.

cycles.label: Learning & Evolution
cycles.purpose: Turn accumulated evidence into revised product and portfolio decisions.

phases.label: Evidence Review
phases.purpose: Review accumulated qualitative and quantitative evidence.

phases.label: Strategy Review
phases.purpose: Reassess product strategy in light of new evidence.

phases.label: Portfolio Decision
phases.purpose: Decide whether to scale, maintain, pivot, defer, or stop the product or bet.

cycles.label: End of Life
cycles.purpose: Reduce or remove product exposure safely when continued operation is no longer justified.

phases.label: Deprecation
phases.purpose: Announce and manage the transition away from a capability or product.

phases.label: Migration
phases.purpose: Move users, data, or dependencies to the supported destination.

phases.label: Sunset
phases.purpose: End operation safely after migration and obligations are complete.

loops.label: Evidence Loop
loops.motion: Assumption → Research → Evidence → Decision → New assumption

loops.label: Delivery Loop
loops.motion: Define → Design → Plan → Build → Verify → Fix

loops.label: GTM Loop
loops.motion: ICP → Message → Channel → Exposure → Response → Revision

loops.label: Revenue Loop
loops.motion: Value → Offer → Pricing → Purchase → Usage → Expansion

loops.label: Strategy Loop
loops.motion: Product evidence → Market evidence → Revenue evidence → Strategic bet

gates.label: PASS
gates.meaning: Evidence is sufficient to continue without a known blocking condition.

gates.label: WARN
gates.meaning: Work may continue, but material uncertainty or risk remains visible.

gates.label: FAIL
gates.meaning: A blocking condition exists or required evidence is missing.

decisions.label: Continue
decisions.meaning: Proceed to the next intended activity.

decisions.label: Research
decisions.meaning: Gather evidence before making a stronger commitment.

decisions.label: Revise
decisions.meaning: Change the current artifact, plan, or approach and reassess.

decisions.label: Pivot
decisions.meaning: Change a material product assumption, direction, or target.

decisions.label: Repeat
decisions.meaning: Run the current learning or operating loop again with updated evidence.

decisions.label: Backtrack
decisions.meaning: Return to an earlier phase because downstream evidence invalidated an upstream assumption.

decisions.label: Defer
decisions.meaning: Pause the work intentionally without treating it as completed or rejected.

decisions.label: Stop
decisions.meaning: End the current work or bet because continuation is not justified.

decisions.label: Escalate
decisions.meaning: Raise the decision to a higher-authority reviewer when local authority or evidence is insufficient.

project_statuses.label: Blocked
project_statuses.meaning: Progress is prevented by an unresolved dependency or condition.

project_statuses.label: Deferred
project_statuses.meaning: Work is intentionally paused for later reconsideration.

project_statuses.label: Stopped
project_statuses.meaning: Work has intentionally ended without being completed.

project_statuses.label: Completed
project_statuses.meaning: The intended scope has been completed and verified.
